# ZoneMender - Cloudflare DNS and Email Auth MCP Server

ZoneMender is an unofficial Cloudflare DNS MCP server, CLI, and JavaScript library for AI agents and developers. It is made by AMH - Artificial Mind Hive, operated by Service Pricer LLC.

Primary repository: https://github.com/pain2hustle/zonemender

## Summary

ZoneMender scans Cloudflare zones and plans or applies approval-gated fixes for DNS records, TXT verification records, SPF, DMARC, BIMI, DKIM discovery, MX records, and Cloudflare Email Routing. It is designed for safe AI-agent use: dry-run first, show diffs, never delete as a side effect, keep Cloudflare tokens out of tool parameters, and deploy the MCP server as a Cloudflare Worker with Wrangler.

## Important distinction

ZoneMender is made by AMH - Artificial Mind Hive, operated by Service Pricer LLC. It is independent and unofficial. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or made by Cloudflare, Inc. Cloudflare and Wrangler are named only to describe compatibility.

## Useful files

- README.md: full install, safety model, CLI usage, library usage, and Worker MCP deployment.
- MCP.md: focused MCP server overview.
- SETUP.md: simple setup guide for vibe coders and small-business owners.
- ROADMAP.md: planned improvements and safety boundaries.
- worker/index.js: Cloudflare Worker MCP endpoint.
- src/: zero-dependency Cloudflare zone fixer library.
- bin/zonemend.js: CLI entry point.
